Battle
In December 1476, Vlad III Dracula was killed in battle while defending Wallachia against forces supported by the Ottoman Empire and Basarab Laiotă. The engagement took place near Bucharest shortly after Vlad had regained the Wallachian throne for a brief third reign. During the fighting, Vlad was killed, and according to several historical accounts, his head was cut off and sent to Sultan Mehmed II in Constantinople as proof of his death.
The exact size of the armies and total casualties remain unknown, as contemporary sources do not provide precise figures.
